title: Handover with Maggie Fitzsimmons: access and data across an ICB
summary: Maggie Fitzsimmons and Dr Ben Walker discuss access, data quality and shared technology across primary and secondary care.
body_markdown:
Maggie Fitzsimmons, who leads Strategic Partnerships at Anima, joins Dr Ben Walker for this episode of Handover. Their conversation looks at access and data quality at ICB level.


To play this YouTube video here, allow marketing cookies.


[Watch on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yFgxWvbJgRY)


## Working across organisational boundaries


The discussion asks how primary and secondary care could benefit from a shared platform, rather than each practice working in a separate system. Watch the full conversation for Maggie’s perspective on what that could mean for integrated care.
